radius.$description: Corner radii. Themes may change these to set how round a brand feels.

sm.$description: Small radius, for compact elements such as tags.

md.$description: Medium radius, for buttons and inputs.

lg.$description: Large radius, for cards and dialogs.

full.$description: Fully rounded ends, for pills and circular controls.

border-width.$description: Border widths. Locked: the focus ring width is an accessibility minimum.

focus.$description: The width of the focus ring. Never less than 2px.

size.$description: Fixed sizes that do not change with density.

minimum.$description: The smallest touch target. Locked: an accessibility minimum.

md.$description: Icons inside medium and large controls.
